description: Defines enums, structs, and conversion functions related to PSUP PDU session information, including PDU types, paging policy indicators, and session data structures for downlink and uplink, following 3GPP TS 38.415 specifications.

classes.name: psup_dl_pdu_session_information
classes.description: Represents downlink PDU session information with fields for PDU type, QoS indicator, QoS flow ID, optional paging policy indicator, timestamp, and sequence number.

classes.name: psup_ul_pdu_session_information
classes.description: Represents uplink PDU session information with fields for PDU type, QoS flow ID, optional timestamps, delay results, and sequence number.

methods.name: psup_pdu_type_to_uint
methods.description: Converts a psup_pdu_type enum value to its corresponding uint8_t representation.

methods.name: uint_to_psup_pdu_type
methods.description: Converts a uint8_t value to its corresponding psup_pdu_type enum value.

methods.name: psup_ppi_to_uint
methods.description: Converts a psup_ppi enum value to its corresponding uint8_t representation.

methods.name: uint_to_psup_ppi
methods.description: Converts a uint8_t value to its corresponding psup_ppi enum value.
